messages.subject: loading MCMCTree output files for ggtree usage?
parts:
Hello all,

I have been trying to work with mcmctree tree files with ggtree with some limited success.  Ideally, I would like to use ggtree's range plotting functionality.  Has anyone had any luck with importing mcmctree files into R for use in ggtree?

This is an example of such a tree from the PAML tutorials for mcmctree:

#NEXUS
BEGIN TREES;

UTREE 1 = ((((human: 0.070043, (chimpanzee: 0.035170, bonobo: 0.035170) [&95%={0.001818, 0.0716821}]: 0.034872) [&95%={0.0600013, 0.0800095}]: 0.034773, gorilla: 0.104816) [&95%={0.0684955, 0.147579}]: 0.035002, (orangutan: 0.069718, sumatran: 0.069718) [&95%={0.0034609, 0.141873}]: 0.070100) [&95%={0.119987, 0.159986}]: 0.444814, gibbon: 0.584632) [&95%={0.16373, 1.00612}];

END;
